name: Central Post Office
summary: Post hall opposite the cathedral: step in for the 1892 and 1936 maps on a short stop from the square. The building is at 2 Công trường Công xã Paris. Alfred Foulhoux and Henri Auguste Vildieu are the named architects, and the materials came from the Eiffel company. Gustave Eiffel is a credit that appears in error.
timeNeeded: A short stop on the cathedral walk. Check on arrival.
getThere: With the cathedral, on the same square.
heroCaption: The post office facade and the clock, from the square

notice.title: Two architect credits
notice.body: Alfred Foulhoux and Henri Auguste Vildieu are the named architects. Gustave Eiffel is sometimes given the credit in error. The design was based on his blueprints.

body: The hall is at 2 Công trường Công xã Paris, Phường Sài Gòn, opposite the cathedral. The older label is Ben Nghe, District 1. The interior is compared with the Gare d’Orsay. Two painted maps hang at the main door: Saigon and the surroundings in 1892, and Nam Kỳ in 1936. Wooden phone booths and a portrait of Hồ Chí Minh are in the hall, and souvenir stalls line the corridors.

Admission is free. Another clock is 7:30 a.m.–12 p.m. and 1:30–5 p.m. Use the board at the door. Pair the stop with the morning look at the cathedral. From the Jade Emperor Pagoda the distance is about 2.6 km.

gettingThere: Walk with the cathedral. From the Jade Emperor Pagoda the distance is about 2.6 km.
